subject.title: fix(openai): correct Realtime auth and transcription secrets

question: Should OpenAI Realtime voice and transcription stop treating Codex/ChatGPT OAuth as usable auth for public Platform Realtime endpoints, even though that removes the recently merged OAuth fallback for existing OAuth-only users?
rationale: The patch matches the official Realtime client-secret API and Codex auth-source separation, but it intentionally changes an upgrade-sensitive provider-auth fallback that was added by recent merged history.

options.title: Land API-key-only Realtime auth
options.body: Accept the compatibility change because public OpenAI Realtime client-secret requests require Platform API-key auth and Codex OAuth belongs to the ChatGPT/Codex backend path.

options.title: Preserve fallback temporarily
options.body: Keep OAuth-only discovery as a documented compatibility mode and limit this PR to transcription endpoint and error-message fixes until an explicit migration or doctor path exists.

options.title: Split diagnostics follow-up
options.body: Merge the core auth boundary now and leave Azure/proxy/custom-endpoint diagnostic polish to the adjacent open diagnostic PR if maintainers still want it.

recommendation.title: Land API-key-only Realtime auth
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility change because public OpenAI Realtime client-secret requests require Platform API-key auth and Codex OAuth belongs to the ChatGPT/Codex backend path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Realtime auth-direction work and this PR's current API-boundary proof both route the product/merge-risk choice to steipete.
